title: Dilution with CSV File and Custom Tube Rack
author: Opentrons
materials: Sample and diluent is mixed after dispensing sample.

steps.title: Set temperature module
steps.instruction: Place the custom 40‑tube rack on the temperature module and set the module temperature to 4 °C.

steps.title: Load CSV and configure parameters
steps.instruction: Upload a .csv file with header line "Diluent Transfer Volume (ul), Dispense Tube (rack), Source Well, Sample Transfer Volume" (e.g., 1000, A1, A1, 20). Specify tip‑tracking option (start at A1 or continue), the initial diluent volume in A1 of the 6‑tube rack (in mL), and which mounts (left or right) hold the P20 and P1000 pipettes.

steps.title: Transfer diluent to final rack
steps.instruction: For each row in the CSV, pick up a fresh tip, aspirate the listed Diluent Transfer Volume (µL) from the source well, dispense it into the indicated dispense tube (rack) located in slot 1, and then discard the tip to avoid low‑viscosity cross‑contamination. Track liquid height in the diluent tube rack after each aspiration.

steps.title: Transfer sample to final rack
steps.instruction: For each row in the CSV, pick up a fresh tip, aspirate the listed Sample Transfer Volume (µL) from the source well, dispense it into the same tube in slot 1, and discard the tip to prevent cross‑contamination.

steps.title: Mix sample with diluent
steps.instruction: After each sample dispense, mix the sample and diluent in the tube (e.g., by pipette up‑and‑down) using the same tip that delivered the sample, then discard the tip.
